description: What the daemon's HTTP routes answer, for a host's backend, the command line and the viewer. A person's and a host's routes answer {"ok": true, "data": <one of these>}; the agent routes answer AgentManifest and ToolResult as they are. A refusal is an HTTP error status with a Refusal.

Refusal.description: Why a request was refused, with its HTTP status. A body that is not the right shape has a list of what is wrong with it instead of one sentence.

RefusalProblem.description: One thing wrong with a request's body.

TokenKind.description: What a token is for: an agent's tools, a person's viewer, a host's namespaces, or everything.

SessionKind.description: What a spent login code or embed ticket opens: a viewer, a framed viewer, or a viewer that may change settings.

Health.description: GET /healthz: that the daemon is up. Given a nonce, proof that it holds the admin token; given a token's id too, proof that it knows that token.

proof.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the nonce, keyed by the admin token; null when no nonce was given.

token_proof.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the nonce, keyed by the hex SHA-256 of the named token; null when no nonce or no known token id was given.

Stopped.description: DELETE on a scope: whether its device was running and has been let go.

DeviceList.description: GET a scope's devices: the simulators it could use, for a picker.

RecordingFile.description: One file a recording was kept as.

name.description: The file's name in the recordings folder; GET /recordings/{name} serves it.

path.description: Where it is on this Mac.

Recording.description: A recording of a device's screen that was kept.

device.description: The name of the device recorded.

started_at.description: When it began, as an ISO 8601 time in UTC.

notes.description: What a person should know about it, such as touches not drawn.

RecordingList.description: GET a scope's recordings: those kept, newest first, and the one under way on its device.

TouchSetupState.description: How touching a scope's real device stands: nothing to set up (a simulator, or none running), WebDriverAgent turned off, touch working, no team known to sign WebDriverAgent, a person's Set up touch offered, WebDriverAgent being built, being started on the device, or failed and why.

TeamSource.description: Where the team that signs for a real device came from: the scope's project, real_devices.team_id, or the only team this Mac signs for.

TouchSetup.description: GET a scope's /device/touch: whether its real device can be touched, and what a person can do. POST it: set touch up -- build WebDriverAgent for the device, or start it again when it is built -- answering how it then stands.

message.description: What to tell a person; empty when there is nothing to say.

team.description: The team that signs WebDriverAgent here, when one is known.

Chosen.description: PUT a scope's device: the simulator it uses from now on.

EmbedTicket.description: POST a scope's embed tickets: the path a page frames, with a one-shot ticket in its fragment, and how long the ticket lasts.

Exchanged.description: POST /api/v1/auth/exchange: a viewer token for the scope a login code or embed ticket was for.

Lease.description: POST an agent's lease: its scope's device is not stopped as idle for this long.

TokenRecord.description: A token as it may be shown: never the token itself, nor its digest.

scopes.description: Scope ids, `name:*` for a namespace, or `*` for every scope.

roots.description: The folders its agents may reach.

created.description: When it was made, in seconds since the epoch.

host.description: The id of the host token that made it; empty when the admin did.

MadeToken.description: A token just made: its record, and the token itself, which is never shown again.

TokenList.description: GET the tokens a host made.

Revoked.description: DELETE a token: whether there was one to revoke.

AgentTool.description: A tool as an MCP manifest lists it.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema of its arguments.

AgentManifest.description: GET /api/v1/agent/manifest, not wrapped in an Answer: the tools an agent is offered and how to use them -- or none, and why, in instructions.

ImageContent.description: An image in a tool result, base64-encoded.

ToolResult.description: POST /api/v1/agent/call, not wrapped in an Answer: an MCP tool result. A refused or failed call is a result with isError, not an HTTP error.
